statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these symptoms
